faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about bookings, payments and consultations.
faq.come_prenoto: How do I book a consultation?
faq.come_prenoto_b: open the profile, choose a date, a length and an available time, and complete the payment. Confirmation is sent by email.
faq.durata_testo: The minimum length is 60 minutes. When you book you can choose 60, 90 or 120 minutes.
faq.video: How does the video call work?
faq.video_testo: The consultation takes place on the platform, in the built-in video call: you do not install another program. If recording was chosen when booking, the call is recorded. A reminder is sent before the appointment.
faq.annulla: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.annulla_testo: If recording was chosen when you booked, the call is recorded and you can open a dispute within 48 hours after the end. The people who verify profiles and the people who administer the site review the video, also with the help of an automatic analysis. If the dispute is accepted, you receive the consultation price back, not the service fee of {n} €. Without a recording, a dispute is not available. If you cancel in time, or if the consultant does not attend, the refund also includes the service fee.
faq.diventa: How do I become a consultant?
faq.diventa_testo: Register, complete your profile with your skills and experience, and set your rate and availability. Once the profile has been verified, you can receive bookings.
faq.altro_b: the request is read by support.
termini.bozza: This text is a draft. Whoever runs Ispiramy must review it before treating it as final. It is not legal advice. The legal name, the registered office and the VAT number are still missing: the placeholders below must not be replaced with invented details.
termini.manca_titolo: Operator details still to be added
termini.accetti: These terms govern the use of Ispiramy by anyone who visits the site, opens an account, books a consultation or offers one. Registering, booking or publishing content means you accept this text. If you do not accept it, please do not use the service.
termini.cose_testo: Ispiramy is an online platform. After you sign in you can search for a consultant, book a paid consultation, pay for it, write in the chat and post in the community. The consultant sets the price and the length, either with the hourly rate on the profile or with an offer in which the price and the length are already set.
termini.cose_parte: Consultants are not employees of Ispiramy. The consultation is an agreement between the client and the consultant. Ispiramy is not a party to that agreement: it provides the platform, the payment tools and the video call.
termini.eta_testo: The service is for people aged 18 or over. By creating an account you state that you are an adult. The platform does not ask for your date of birth.
termini.account_testo: An account is required to book, exchange messages and use the community. You can open one with an email address and a password, or with Google. If you register with email, Ispiramy sends a code to confirm the address.
termini.account_dati: The details you enter must be accurate. The password remains yours and must not be shared. Anything done through the account is treated as done by you, until you tell us that someone else has used it.
termini.account_avvisi: Ispiramy sends notices about consultations, messages and service updates by email and, if you turn them on, by push notification.
termini.pubblichi_testo: Your profile, community questions, messages, reviews and the description of the consultation are your content. You keep ownership and you are responsible for them. Ispiramy does not acquire them and does not guarantee that they are accurate. The name Ispiramy, the logo and the platform remain Ispiramy's.
termini.pubblichi_filtro: Some text and some images are blocked automatically when they appear unlawful, offensive, violent or sexual. This is not a review of every item: if the technical check does not respond, a chat message may still be delivered.
termini.segnala_community: In the community, next to a question, there is a Report button. An account and a written reason are required. One report is allowed per question. The people who verify profiles or administer the site read it and may dismiss it or hide the question.
termini.segnala_mail: For unlawful content that is not a community question, you can also write to
termini.condotta_testo: You must not use Ispiramy for unlawful activity, fraud, harassment, threats, hate or sexual content involving minors. You must not present yourself as another person. In the community, requests are questions for help: advertising and text unrelated to that purpose are not allowed.
termini.prezzo_intro: Before paying, the client sees the amount due.
termini.prezzo_min: When you book from the consultant's profile, the price is the hourly rate, at least {n} € per hour, for 60, 90 or 120 minutes.
termini.prezzo_spese: A service fee of {n} € is added to the consultation price. The total is the sum of the two amounts.
termini.offerte: If the client accepts an offer, the price and the length are those stated in the offer. There too, the service fee and the total are shown before payment.
termini.anticipo: A booking is made at least {n} hours in advance, in a time slot the consultant has opened. Times are in Italian time.
termini.paga_metodo: Payment is by card, through Stripe, or with PayPal if the consultant has enabled that method. Ispiramy does not store card numbers: Stripe and PayPal handle them.
termini.paga_auto: With automatic confirmation the amount is charged when you pay and is held by Ispiramy until the consultation has ended.
termini.paga_mano: With manual confirmation by the consultant the amount is subject to a pre-authorization and is not yet charged. The charge is made when the consultant accepts. The consultant replies within {n} hours and, in any event, at least one hour before the start. If the consultant declines the request or does not reply in time, the pre-authorization is released and the client does not pay. The payment provider may continue to show that hold for a few days.
termini.paga_interrompi: If the client interrupts the payment, nothing is charged and the consultation is not booked.
termini.commissione: On the consultation price Ispiramy keeps a platform commission, normally {n}%. The service fee stays with Ispiramy and is not paid to the consultant.
termini.compenso: The consultant's payout is released when the client leaves a review, if no dispute is open. If the review does not arrive, it is released {n} hours after the end. While a dispute is open, the payout stays on hold and Ispiramy does not start the transfer to the consultant's Stripe or PayPal account.
termini.annulla_fino: A confirmed consultation may be cancelled up to {n} hours before the start, by the client or by the consultant.
termini.rimborso: If the amount was only a pre-authorization, the pre-authorization is released. If the amount had already been collected, Ispiramy asks Stripe or PayPal to refund what was paid, including the service fee. The cancellation email states that, where the payment was collected, the refund arrives within 5-10 business days on the same payment method.
termini.ritira: A request the consultant has not yet accepted may be withdrawn even close to the time: in that case nothing was charged.
termini.dopo: Once the {n} hours before the start have passed, or once the consultation has started, it can no longer be cancelled from the platform.
termini.assente: At the end of the booked time, if the consultant did not join the call and the client did, the refund is issued automatically, including the service fee. The same applies if neither person joins. If the client does not join and the consultant does, the payment proceeds and there is no refund.
termini.contestazione: After the consultation, only the client who booked can open a dispute, and only if recording is on. Recording is on unless it was turned off before the call: without a recording the dispute does not open. It must be opened within {n} hours of the end of the booked time. Only one dispute is allowed for each consultation.
termini.decisione: While a dispute is open, the payout stays on hold. If recording was chosen, the people who verify profiles or administer the site review the video, also with the help of an automatic analysis. If the dispute is accepted, the client receives the consultation price back, not the service fee of {n} €, which Ispiramy keeps. A partial refund is a percentage of that price. The dispute may also be closed, in which case the payment is sent to the consultant.

termini.def_intro: In these terms the following words have the meaning given here.
termini.def_cliente: Client: the person who books a consultation.
termini.def_consulente: Consultant: the person who offers a consultation through the platform.
termini.def_consulenza: Consultation: the paid video call between the client and the consultant, for the length chosen when booking.
termini.def_auto: Automatic confirmation: the booking is confirmed when payment is made, with no further acceptance by the consultant.
termini.def_manuale: Manual confirmation by the consultant: the booking stays pending until the consultant accepts or declines it.
termini.def_preaut: Pre-authorization: a hold on the payment method, without a charge. The charge is made only if the booking is confirmed.
termini.def_servizio: Service fee: the fixed amount added to the consultation price. It stays with Ispiramy.
termini.def_commissione: Platform commission: the percentage Ispiramy keeps on the consultation price. It is separate from the service fee.
termini.recensioni_testo: After the consultation the client may leave a review. The review is the user's content, and the user is responsible for it. The effect of the review on the consultant's payout is the one described in article 8.
cf.intro_pagina: Ispiramy connects someone who needs a conversation with someone who has already dealt with that subject. The consultation takes place on a video call, for the time that was booked, on the platform.
